name: Facundo Sharry
about: I am in the process of finishing my Computer Science degree and I've been working in web development for 3 years now. I design and implement full-stack systems — with an emphasis on performance, testability, and maintainability.
about2:
I have been studying Computer Science at the National University of Córdoba, Argentina since 2021. Throughout my studies I have built a solid foundation in areas such as algorithms, data structures, software development, and database management, enabling me to apply analytical thinking and problem-solving to real-world challenges.

In 2023 I began working as a full-stack developer at the university's College of Odontology. I am passionate about digitalization and reducing bureaucracy; among other contributions, I helped develop a digital medical records system, bringing many solutions to our users and clients.
